a: Pin versions and use lockfiles for reproducible builds.
Generate SBOMs to know what you shipped.
Provenance links artifacts to source and build systems.
Attackers publish similarly named packages; verify publishers.
CI tokens should have least privilege and short life.
Review new dependencies on every PR for risk.
Verify checksums of critical downloaded binaries.
Mirror approved packages to reduce reliance on public registries.
Monitor for sudden maintainer changes and unusual releases.
